From its humble beginnings in Bowling Green, to residencies at multiple venues in Toledo, The Ination has proven itself a survivor of time, while it continues to thrive - hosting diverse LBGTQ+ friendly events across the state. events.title: CULTURA X
events.description:
Wake up Foos 

November is coming in HOT.

Not Ur Amigo xx Oscura present: Cultura X 

A night of high energy and good company. 

HEADLINING: ALEROJ 
 
Bogotá DJ, producer, and cultural manager Aleroj co-founded Muakk records and mixes guaracha, juke, reggaeton, ghetto house, and techno. He's helping shape the uwuaracha sound across Latin America's cyber-scene, with sets that have reached Boiler Room, HÖR, Rinse FM, and NTS.

In addition, we have Raphaël, 
who has brought his global rave sounds to multiple stages alongside names such as Amor Satyr, Siu Mata, Sheefy Mcfly and DJ Assault.

Stepping into the bat cave, we have our Goth residents Kenjiro and Lady Witch giving you every shade of darkness that you can lose yourself in.

Our night will be hosted by Camilla Cantu keeping the night moving with a special song performance. 

Tickets at the Door.

events.title: Sanctuary: Offering - 1 Year Anniversary
events.description:
Three clubs ☆ One ticket ☆ Ten hours given over to the queer underground

Following our autumn descent, Sanctuary returns at the threshold of winter on Saturday, November 28, with an Offering.

One year ago, we opened the doors to Sanctuary with a simple promise: your home away from home.

A year later, that home has grown across rooms, dance floors, friendships, sweat, sound, and countless hours spent together in the dark. For our first anniversary, we return with an Offering: a celebration of what each of us brings to this space, what we give to one another, and what we have built together.

For one year, Sanctuary has asked you to make yourself at home. For our anniversary, we ask you to bring something of yourself with you.

This is your home away from home. This is our Offering.

events.title: What Sounds I'm Sitting On
events.description:
A full year of “What Sounds I'm Sitting On," Wrcklés quarterly listening session & jam at Moondog Café. Welcoming the one-and-only Detroit vocal artist/producer Monica Blaire and emerging Detroit singer/songwriter/producer Shaii David to bless our ears.  

"[I] loved all the guest we been able to have share original music and have a space and sounding board for music they have yet to put out, dig deep on songs they have, or giving a gift of hearing something that may never be put out just for the art of a dope listening experience. It’s been great to personally test out music too that I intend on releasing and each “what sounds I’m sitting on” has let me dial the music in a bit more and lets me get inspired. Hope you can make it to the last one of the year before I drop “Interlewds” as always it’s a listening session with a jam at the end for everyone who wants to bring an instrument, bars, and vocals." - Wrcklés
